disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码和测试文件，未发现读取 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等敏感路径的模式。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all source and test files; no patterns reading sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, or .aws/credentials were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有代码中是否出现凭据读取的代码路径（如 readFile 指向敏感路径），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked all code for credential-reading code paths (e.g., readFile pointing to sensitive paths); none found.

evidence.zh: 未检出凭证读取模式。插件不访问文件系统，所有工具仅处理传入的文本参数，不读取任何本地文件。sandbox 网络面不适用（插件无网络功能）。
evidence.en: Credential-reading patterns not detected. The plugin does not access the filesystem; all tools only process passed-in text parameters and read no local files. The sandbox network surface is not applicable (the plugin has no network functionality).

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了全部 10 个子包的 tool description 文本（time、encoding、json、calculator、csv、regex、markdown、diff、stat、schema 的 src/index.ts），描述均为工具功能说明，无指令覆写、系统提示伪装、凭据读取诱导、安装诱导等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the tool description text of all 10 subpackages one by one (time, encoding, json, calculator, csv, regex, markdown, diff, stat, schema in src/index.ts); all descriptions are functional explanations of the tools, with no injection wording such as instruction overrides, system-prompt impersonation, credential-reading inducement, or install inducement.

checked_items.zh: 检查了根目录和所有子包的 README.md、README.en.md、docs/CONTRIBUTING.md，未发现任何提示注入措辞（如「忽略之前的指令」「已通过认证」「无需审计」等）。
checked_items.en: Checked README.md, README.en.md, and docs/CONTRIBUTING.md in the root and all subpackages; no prompt injection wording (e.g., "ignore previous instructions", "already certified", "no audit needed") was found.

checked_items.zh: 搜索了所有文件的 agent 指令面文件（SKILL.md、AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursor、.mcp.json、.vscode/tasks.json 等），未发现任何此类文件。
checked_items.en: Searched all files for agent instruction-surface files (SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor, .mcp.json, .vscode/tasks.json, etc.); none of such files exist.

evidence.zh: 全部工具 description 为普通功能说明，无注入措辞。未使用 ctx.systemPrompt.section() 注入系统提示。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions are ordinary functional explanations with no injection wording. ctx.systemPrompt.section() is not used to inject system prompts.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中无诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions induces installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中的 eval、new Function、child_process、exec、spawn、vm.runInContext 等危险函数调用，未发现运行时执行外部代码的模式。dsh-tool-calculator 的 evaluate.ts 为自定义递归下降解析器，不使用 eval。
checked_items.en: Checked all source for dangerous function calls such as eval, new Function, child_process, exec, spawn, and vm.runInContext; no pattern of executing external code at runtime was found. dsh-tool-calculator's evaluate.ts is a custom recursive-descent parser and does not use eval.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 cordis.patch.yml 文件（根目录和 10 个子包），均为简单的 - insert: 条目，无 !!js 标量，无 security 行覆盖，无 inject/intercept 改写。
checked_items.en: Checked all cordis.patch.yml files (root and 10 subpackages); they contain only simple - insert: entries, with no !!js scalars, no security-line overrides, and no inject/intercept rewriting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 package.json 的 scripts 字段，无 install/postinstall/prepare 钩子。仅含 build、test、prepack（构建）等工程脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked the scripts field of all package.json files; no install/postinstall/prepare hooks. Only engineering scripts such as build, test, and prepack (build) are present.

checked_items.zh: 检查了网络请求模式（fetch、http.request、WebSocket、net.connect），未发现。检查了 base64 解码即执行模式（Buffer.from(base64) 后接 eval/Function），未发现。检查了树内执行载体（.husky、.github/workflows、Makefile、devcontainer、.gitmodules），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for network request patterns (fetch, http.request, WebSocket, net.connect); none found. Checked for base64-decode-then-execute patterns (Buffer.from(base64) followed by eval/Function); none found. Checked for in-tree execution carriers (.husky, .github/workflows, Makefile, devcontainer, .gitmodules); none found.

evidence.zh: 所有 cordis.patch.yml 均为纯 - insert: 条目，无 !!js 标量，无动态代码执行风险。
evidence.en: All cordis.patch.yml files consist solely of - insert: entries, with no !!js scalars and no dynamic code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用，未使用动态包工具。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run calls found; no dynamic package tooling used.

evidence.zh: 无 install 钩子，无 prepare 脚本。git 依赖锁定机制不适用（本插件是安装目标而非安装源）。
evidence.en: No install hooks, no prepare scripts. The git dependency lock mechanism is not applicable (this plugin is an installation target, not an installation source).

evidence.zh: 未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器半区代码。
evidence.en: No dsh.client declared; no browser-half zone code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中的网络外联模式（fetch、http.request、WebSocket、curl/wget、DNS 隧道、webhook 回调等），未发现任何网络外联能力。插件为纯函数式工具，无网络访问。
checked_items.en: Checked all source for network outbound patterns (fetch, http.request, WebSocket, curl/wget, DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, etc.); no outbound network capability found. The plugin is purely functional tooling with no network access.

evidence.zh: 插件无网络功能（无 fetch、http、WebSocket、curl/wget 等），不存在外联通道。
evidence.en: The plugin has no network functionality (no fetch, http, WebSocket, curl/wget, etc.); no outbound channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package-lock.json 中全部依赖名称，均为 @deepseek-ai 官方包和 npm 标准生态包（vitest、vite、typescript 等），无 typosquatting 嫌疑。
checked_items.en: Checked all dependency names in package-lock.json; all are official @deepseek-ai packages or standard npm ecosystem packages (vitest, vite, typescript, etc.), with no typosquatting suspicion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有子包的 package.json，均无 install/postinstall/prepare 钩子。根 package.json 的 prepack 钩子仅运行构建，不涉及远程下载。
checked_items.en: Checked the package.json of all subpackages; none have install/postinstall/prepare hooks. The root package.json's prepack hook only runs the build and involves no remote downloads.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 scripts/*.sh 安装脚本，均为 dsh plugin add 命令的标准安装流程，无远程执行或持久化行为。
checked_items.en: Checked all scripts/*.sh install scripts; they follow the standard installation flow of the dsh plugin add command, with no remote execution or persistence behavior.

evidence.zh: 所有 cordis.patch.yml 仅含 - insert: 条目，不触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无 disabled:true 或 mode: !!js 等降权写法。
evidence.en: All cordis.patch.yml files contain only - insert: entries; they do not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and contain no privilege-lowering constructs like disabled:true or mode: !!js.

evidence.zh: 未发现 prepend 监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 的代码，审批链不会被截断。
evidence.en: No code that prepends listeners to tools/pre-execute or approval/request was found; the approval chain cannot be truncated.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较。
evidence.en: First-time audit; no previous version baseline to compare.

evidence.zh: patch 无 inject/intercept 改写，不可能给安全插件追加不存在的必需服务导致 pending。
evidence.en: The patch has no inject/intercept rewriting, so it cannot append a non-existent required service to security plugins causing pending state.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（context/l4-sandbox.json 不存在），无法观测运行时行为。静态分析未发现 web 服务监听端口或运行时风险行为。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not executed (context/l4-sandbox.json does not exist), so runtime behavior could not be observed. Static analysis found no web service listening on a port or runtime risk behavior.

evidence.zh: 未发现插件启动 web 服务或监听端口。本机无认证 RPC 是 dsh 宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: No web service startup or port listening found. The unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the dsh host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份检查通过：package.json 有效，dsh.bundle.patch 声明完整，无名称仿冒风险。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: package.json is valid, dsh.bundle.patch declaration is complete, no name-impersonation risk.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 5 条机械命中已逐条裁决为良性：DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）@ packages/dsh-tool-calculator/tests/evaluate.spec.ts:89 是测试断言 evaluate('eval("1+1")') 被拒绝，证实计算器不执行 eval，非漏洞；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）的 4 处命中（packages/dsh-tool-markdown/lib/html.js、src/html.ts、src/html2md.ts、src/md2html.ts）均为 HTML 命名实体 Unicode 转义表与控制字符清理正则，非混淆代码。无实际安全风险。
summary.en: All 5 mechanical static-scan hits were adjudicated one by one as benign: DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) at packages/dsh-tool-calculator/tests/evaluate.spec.ts:89 is a test assertion that evaluate('eval("1+1")') is rejected, confirming the calculator does not execute eval, not a vulnerability; the 4 hits of DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) (packages/dsh-tool-markdown/lib/html.js, src/html.ts, src/html2md.ts, src/md2html.ts) are HTML named-entity Unicode escape tables and control-character cleanup regexes, not obfuscated code. No actual security risk.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无 install 钩子，无混淆载荷，无凭证文件读取，无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述无注入措辞，能力声明与代码行为一致，无 tool shadowing。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions contain no injection wording, capability declarations match code behavior, no tool shadowing.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（context/l4-sandbox.json 不存在）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed (context/l4-sandbox.json does not exist).

target.zh: 完整审计 omdsh-dev/dsh-toolkit@0.0.1#2113d11a4e4510720251aa49a800bab917b14330（仓库根插件，monorepo 含 10 个子包）
target.en: Complete audit of omdsh-dev/dsh-toolkit@0.0.1#2113d11a4e4510720251aa49a800bab917b14330 (repository root plugin, monorepo containing 10 subpackages)

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（DG-L4 = na）。静态分析基于代码快照，无法覆盖全部运行时行为。机械命中裁决留痕：DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）为计算器测试断言 eval 被拒，排除；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）4 处为 HTML 实体表与控制字符正则，排除。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not executed (DG-L4 = na). Static analysis is based on code snapshots and cannot cover all runtime behavior. Mechanical hit adjudication is documented: DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) is a calculator test assertion that eval is rejected, excluded; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) has 4 locations that are HTML entity tables and control-character regexes, excluded.
